feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 17 June 2026 5:35am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

S or SW 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 for a time later morning and early afternoon.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate becoming slight for a time.


##Weather)##

Mist/fog patches and patchy rain at first soon clearing to become mainly fair. Rain arriving later in the night.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and mist and very poor in any fog patches at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing.


##Wind)##

S or SW 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the afternoon.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate becoming mainly moderate.


##Weather)##

##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and rain and very poor in fog later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
